uncertain: Key "引き継げる強化パーツがありません。 starts with a stray quote byte (inventory: referenced only at +1); the English omits it.

第 = "Episode " and 話 = " " (a lone space): the Japanese assembles 第+N+話(+までクリア). English cannot be empty, so 話 is a space; "Episode 12  cleared" may show a double space. までクリア keeps a leading space so 最終話/プロローグ + までクリア reads "Final Episode cleared".
話 分岐シナリオ = ": Route Split", assuming it follows 第+N ("Episode 31: Route Split").

未定 / 削除 / 条件未達 / 初回プレイ / ２回目プレイ / ボーナス / 遊び sit in one table beside OS-dialog 購入 / ダウンロード (a DLC status/category list?). 削除 = "Delete" (an action, beside Purchase/Download); 未定 = "Undecided"; 遊び = "For Fun" is a guess at a DLC category.
周回ボーナス = "playthrough bonus"; the 「コンプリート」/「クリア」 bonuses are kept literal as "Complete"/"Clear" (probably bonuses for carried-in Jigoku save data).
プレゼントシナリオ = "Gift Scenario" (coined).
Game titles coined as "3rd Super Robot Wars Z Tengoku-hen / Jigoku-hen / Rengoku-hen" (no existing project rendering; Jigoku chart art used "TIME OF HELL").

ＮＴ－Ｄシステム・５ターン / ・緑 / ・バンシィ, ラムダ・ドライバ１００, GAIモード１４０/１２０ and ゼロシステム１ look like internal ability-variant names; rendered as "NT-D System (5 Turns)" etc. ゼロシステム follows the catalog "ZERO System" (Jigoku abilities used "Zero System").
スフィア発動 = "Sphere Activation" (coined; the catalog drops 発動 for ＧＡＩモード発動 = "GAI Mode", but a bare "Sphere" seemed too ambiguous).
Save-description template: 主人公 = "Hero", クリア数 = "Clears"; the columns are re-padded with ASCII spaces.
Scenario-clear-bonus labels (　資金　　　： etc.) are padded with trailing spaces to align the values, as the Japanese aligns its colons.
